notes.title: January 4th Update
notes.content:
We have optimized the game.
If the performance is slow, adjusting the following settings can reduce GPU load and improve processing speed:

・Go to Settings → Graphics Settings and change Shadows from "Highest" to "High."

notes.title: October 28 Update
notes.content: The lighting load has been reduced to make the game more comfortable.

notes.title: September 11th Update
notes.content: Korean has been added to the language settings.

notes.title: August 24th Update
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where numbers were unreadable when the texture was rough.
- Some dialogue has been added.

notes.title: Update August 18
notes.content: We have optimized the graphics processing to provide a smoother gaming experience.

notes.title: Update on August 15
notes.content:
・We have narrowed the field of view for the monster and reduced its speed during pursuit.
・The respawn location for the second save point has been changed.
・To make it easier to collect endings, an additional save point has been added.

notes.title: August 10 Update
notes.content: We have fixed an issue that allowed players to interact with gimmicks that should not be able to be examined.

notes.title: August 8 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where items could not be obtained.
- Changed some lines of dialogue.

notes.title: August 4th Update
notes.content:
A true ending has been added.
The condition is to have a specific item.

notes.title: August 3 Update
notes.content: Fixed a bug that made SE interesting in sad scenes.

notes.title: August 2 Update2
notes.content: Fixed a bug that prevented progress when talking to rice.

notes.title: August 2nd Update
notes.content: You have fixed an issue where closing a sliding door from the inside would cause it to not open and make it impossible to proceed.
